body.x: SECULINE introduced its “ENEROID”, an automatic AA battery charger, at “CES (Consumer Technology Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th at Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC).“CES”, which is held every year in January by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, showcasing global trends in the electronics and IT industry.AVING News, which has sent reporters to CES for 11 years, will introduce various up-to-date technologies and products showcased at CES 2016. Based on keen reports and research at CES, AVING News will hold the “CES 2016 Review Conference” at Korea AVING Studio on Wednesday the 28th.→ Go to 'CES 2016' news page
